text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year~, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that the purification is complete,
shall we go make our prayer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I lined up with Grass Wonder to offer prayers, and after waiting for a while, our turn came.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I pray for?
choice_data_list: May Grass's running shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*clap clap!*)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, were you concerned about my health?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just that fact alone
seems to fill me right up with energy~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With this, would it be okay if I pushed myself just a little too hard in training?
...Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*clap clap!*)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Stronger, you say...? Fufufu,
you certainly expect a lot from me, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll become a much, muuuuch stronger "monster"
and... gobble Trainer-san right up, maybe?
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*clap clap!*)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The sharpness of my stride, you say?
I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
True, starting this year, she'll be moving up to the Senior division,
where all the seasoned veterans gather...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let us hone our skills even further~. I'm counting on you, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, now that we've finished our shrine visit~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We'll be training once we get back to the academy,
so since we have the chance,
shall we take a leisurely walk back?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It'd be a waste not to soak in such a lively and festive atmosphere~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we slowly stroll through the shrine grounds,
which are wrapped in the lively bustle of the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, Grass Wonder looked spacey
the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could this be what they call the New Year's slump?
Fufu, that really won't do~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm.
Then, let's start with warm-upsâ"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was at that moment that "she" appeared.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Appearing like a raging gale,
her trademark is her crimson outfit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Descending upon the battlefield of the turf is none other than the godspeed "Monster Bird"!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The "World's Strongest," El Condor Pasa!!Has! Arrived! Right! Heeeere, yeeesss!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Fighting spirit concealed behind a quiet smile.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The quiet flame in her eyes blazes upon the turf!
A mysterious deep blue that shakes the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder!!
Now, step into the ring!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Are you saying you want to compete?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El. I'm sorry, but my schedule
after this is already packed, so...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Are you afraid, YES?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Showing such disgrace as at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was watching, Grass.
Your run in the Arima Kinen.
Your showdown with Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It was truly—truly boring!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No heart-pounding thrill! No soul-shaking fire!
There was so little passion, I almost caught a cold.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …………To you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What could you possibly know, El?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can't even challenge her anymore!!
I can't even reach out for the title of "Monster" anymore, so what am I—!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Look at me!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am the lightning-fast "Monstrous Bird"!!
The "World's Strongest," El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words!!
A massive wall blocking the path to the "Pinnacle"!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For you, walking toward the summit at the end of the road, this is the challenge to face!
The wall you must overcome!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, just like Maruzensky!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“You can't even reach out for the title of ‘Monster’?
What on earth are you talking about?!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What you were aiming for.
What was always reflected in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ――Was that merely at the level of a "monster"?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I retract my statement about stepping into the ring.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if I competed against you right now...
El's soul would end up completely chilled to the bone, you know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after El Condor Pasa left,
Grass Wonder remained standing there in a daze
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An aura radiated from her that made it impossible to even speak to her.
After standing in complete silence for a while, she eventually—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if snapped forward like a released spring, she dashed out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you still have the vow document I gave you before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is quiet and calm on the surface, but laden with a burning passion as she asks.
If it's that paper where she wrote "Never Back Down"—
choice_data_list: Of course, I kept it, but...
Of course, I kept it, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then hand it over.
Right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the skin-pricking pressure bearing down on me,
I hurried to take out that very same "Unwavering Resolve" scroll.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting it immediately, Grass Wonder held up the ever-magnificent calligraphy,
and then, without hesitation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Torn to shreds.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“No Retreat.”
...What a joke, “No Retreat.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was frightened.
I was refusing to take a step forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Overwhelmed... by the sheer height and greatness of the wall known as Maruzensky-san.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I was trapped by the name ‘Monster.’

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If the destination at the end of the journey is the summit,
fame and titles will naturally follow anyway.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...However, I will hesitate no longer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The New Year has just begun.
Allow me to pledge myself to you anew, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Grass Wonder
took up her brush once more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: “No Retreat”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No matter what wall stands before me,
I will never back down again!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Until the moment we reach the summit!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. May we set our next target race
as the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just like with the Arima, I want to show everyone once again
in that race where we receive everyone's votes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Witness the running of Grass Wonder, who will soon reach the pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I apologize for making you worry.
